ch.n: Thirty years of know-how behind every restaurant.
ch.txt: Thirty years of know-how behind every restaurant.

Complete site opening assistance, detailed operational manuals, quality audits (QCS), and dedicated ongoing guidance from our European operations team, from your very first location to your tenth and beyond.

Access to the world's only corporate educational facility dedicated exclusively to F&B franchise training, backed by over 30 Ph.D. and Master's-certified R&D researchers to train your managers and staff in authentic recipes and operational excellence.

End-to-end supply chain logistics with guaranteed access to our proprietary marinades, sauces, and ingredients, including our strategic global partnership with Coca-Cola (CCEP) for seamless beverage supply.

Comprehensive grand-opening campaign toolkits, localised PR, high-impact social media strategies, and direct aggregator integrations (Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Glovo, Just Eat) driven by our European marketing coordination team.

Flexible formats (including QSR traditional and flagship locations as well as shop-in-shop formats) designed for high ROI, low initial CAPEX, transparent fee structures, and scalable multi-unit development opportunities.

ch.n: FAQ item – How much does it cost to open a bb.q restaurant? (open)
How much does it cost to open a bb.q restaurant?
ch.txt: How much does it cost to open a bb.q restaurant?
Investment depends on the market and site format. Flagship, traditional restaurant or shop-in-shop. We walk you through investment ranges, fees, and terms during our initial conversation.

ch.n: FAQ item – Do I need restaurant experience? (closed)

ch.txt: While previous experience in the hospitality or food service industry is a strong advantage, it is not strictly mandatory. We provide comprehensive operational training, recipes, and ongoing guidance to ensure your success as a franchisee.

ch.n: FAQ item – Do you only work with multi-unit operators? (closed)
Do you only work with multi-unit operators?
ch.txt: Do you only work with multi-unit operators?

No, we work with both single-unit and multi-unit operators. We look for passionate partners who share our commitment to quality and growth, regardless of whether you are opening your first location or expanding an existing portfolio.

ch.n: FAQ item – Which markets are open? (closed)

ch.txt: We are actively expanding across Europe and globally. Currently, our operations are live in Spain and the UK, with broad opportunities open for enquiries and new franchise developments in all European territories.

ch.n: FAQ item – Do I get an exclusive territory? (closed)
Do I get an exclusive territory?
ch.txt: Do I get an exclusive territory?
Yes, franchise partners are granted a defined exclusive territory to ensure you can build your local customer base and market presence without internal competition.

ch.n: FAQ item – What support do I get at launch? (closed)
What support do I get at launch?
ch.txt: What support do I get at launch?

From day one, you receive end-to-end support including site evaluation guidance, operational and culinary training (at Chicken University), supply chain setup, marketing strategies, and launch campaign coordination.

ch.n: FAQ item – How does delivery work? (closed)

ch.txt: We partner with major delivery aggregators such as Uber Eats, Just Eat, and Glovo (depending on the market). Our dark kitchens and restaurants are fully integrated with these platforms to maximise reach and streamline order management.

ch.n: FAQ item – What happens after I submit my application? (closed)
What happens after I submit my application?
ch.txt: What happens after I submit my application?

Our expansion team reviews your application within 5 working days. If your profile aligns with our goals, we will reach out to schedule an initial introductory call to discuss territories, investment models, and next steps.

ch.n: FAQ item – Is this website a franchise offer? (closed)
Is this website a franchise offer?
ch.txt: Is this website a franchise offer?

This website serves as an informational platform for prospective partners interested in franchise opportunities with bb.q Chicken. It does not constitute a formal franchise offering, which will be provided upon review and approval of your application.
